numinance.kinds.v1.SeparationOfDuties.js.description: SeparationOfDuties names who may not approve; the author is always excluded.

distinct_from.description:
distinct_from names the identities or roles the approver must differ from, beyond the author
 and the author's run: the approver is never the author and the approver's run_id is never the author's run_id.

numinance.kinds.v1.SeparationOfDuties.js.title: Separation Of Duties

numinance.kinds.v1.StageGate.jsonschema..description: StageGate is the gate of a stage. It has two keys, kind and required_approvals; kind is GATE_KIND_PLAN or GATE_KIND_HUMAN (see GateKind).

approver_role.description: approver_role is the customer role whose members may approve.

sod.description: sod is the separation of duties the approval needs.

timeout.description:
timeout is how long the gate waits for a decision before it escalates; absent means it waits without limit.
 Expiry only escalates; it never approves.

numinance.kinds.v1.StageGate.jsonschema..title: Stage Gate

numinance.kinds.v1.StageRegistryEntry.js.description: StageRegistryEntry is one customer stage of the registry.

gate.description: gate is the gate the stage passes through, if any; it only adds a decision, and an absent or weaker gate never removes one.

maps_to.description:
maps_to is required: the Change state this stage is. A stage only names a state; the policy decision of the
 state machine's gate states (PLAN_GATE, RELEASE_GATE) is made whatever gate the stage declares.
maps_to.title: Change State

name.description: name is required: the customer's stage name, unique in the registry.

requires.description: requires names the stages that complete before this one; the order must agree with the state machine's order.

numinance.kinds.v1.StageRegistryEntry.js.title: Stage Registry Entry

numinance.kinds.v1.StageRegistrySpec.jso.description:
StageRegistrySpec lists the customer's stages; the profile context checks
 the DAG over requires and refuses PAUSED.

stages.description: stages is required and non-empty; the loader enforces it, the schema cannot.

numinance.kinds.v1.StageRegistrySpec.jso.title: Stage Registry Spec
